title: Using Artificial French Data to Understand the Emergence of Gender Bias in Transformer Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Generating artificial French text using Probabilistic Context-Free Grammars (PCFGs) with controlled gender distributions, training Transformer language models on this data, and using linguistic probes on the models' contextualized representations to test if they over-assign the majority class (masculine default) or form static gender associations for epicene (gender-neutral) nouns instead of relying on context.
